test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

FRAUDS, SFRAUD, SDFRAU, ?, SDUAFR, SDUARF
solution:
The logic that follows here is

**The last letter is shifted to first, second, third and so on places.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79db2a25cca80c752c3019cb1f020a4f74ce51f7d51d144c4597a4b9f49f31f8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**SDUFRA".**
